links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level), accuracy and comprehensiveness of PEMs for cardiac amyloidosis
links.effect: Median FKGL 10.9 (IQR 9.2, 12.6) for institutional PEMs vs 7.8 (IQR 7.0, 8.8) for GPT-4 revised PEMs; 14/86 (16.3%) of revised PEMs reached at least 6th-grade level; 86/86 (100%) accurate; 9/86 (10.5%) more comprehensive, 3/86 (3.5%) less comprehensive
links.tradeoff: Most revised PEMs (72/86) still did not reach the 6th-grade target; 3/86 (3.5%) were judged less comprehensive than the originals.
links.quote: In comparison, GPT-4 revised PEMs reduced the median FKGL to 7.8 (seventh grade; IQR: 7.0, 8.8, p<0.001), with 14/86 (16.3%) achieving at least a 6th-grade reading level.

design_hint: reading-level simplification prompt with clinician accuracy review
